title: GoniometerComponent - FIFO drain, 45-degree Lissajous, phosphor decay, underflow hold
description:
Wave-2 goniometer component. Depends on d.1 for shared dark-theme colours/style only; no Dependency on CorrelationMeter or PluginEditor.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §9.2 (Goniometer math and phosphor behaviour), §9.4 (AbstractFifo UI drain @ 30–60 Hz)
- Source/DSP/MeterTap.h drain/popPairs API from phase C (UI-thread consumer)
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.* colour conventions from d.1

Implement Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.h/.cpp as a juce::Component:
1. Constructor / setMeterTap (or equivalent) accepts a non-owning pointer/reference to MeterTap (or raw AbstractFifo + buffers if MeterTap exposes drain only). Component never pushes audio; UI thread only.
2. Drain the lock-free FIFO each paint/timer tick driven later by the editor; decimate/cap to ~1–2k points per frame.
3. Plot rotated 45° Lissajous / vectorscope of output L/R:
   x_plot = (R - L) / sqrt(2)  // Side
   y_plot = (L + R) / sqrt(2)  // Mid
   Map into component bounds with origin at center; vertical = mono, horizontal = anti-correlation.
4. Phosphor look: older points drawn with lower alpha (decay); hold last frame on FIFO underflow (paused/stopped audio) — do not clear the plot to blank.
5. paint() is allocation-light on the steady path (reuse point storage reserved in constructor/resized).
6. Square preferred aspect; resized maintains plotting area.

Do not implement CorrelationMeter, PluginEditor, CustomLookAndFeel changes, or CMakeLists.
acceptance_criteria: GoniometerComponent drains MeterTap/AbstractFifo pairs on the UI path
Phosphor-style alpha decay draws older points dimmer; ~1-2k points per frame cap
FIFO underflow holds the last frame rather than clearing
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/MeterTap.* implementation (consume public API only)
modify Source/PluginEditor.*, Source/PluginProcessor.*, Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.*, Source/GUI/RotarySlider.*, Source/GUI/CorrelationMeter.*
allocate or lock on any path intended for the audio thread

allowed: choose concrete drain method name matching MeterTap public API
store points as juce::Point<float> ring or interleaved floats with alpha age
optional crosshair / mono axis guide line
forbidden: block or sleep waiting for FIFO data
